description: The number of concurrent sessions for user accounts is not limited or monitored. This signal indicates that users may establish multiple simultaneous sessions, which may indicate credential sharing or compromise.
applicability: Applicable to all systems with user authentication. Includes web applications, remote access services, and multi-session capable systems where concurrent session limits should be enforced.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through session management configuration review, concurrent session monitoring, and authentication policy assessment.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
